notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Thank you for making Exterminator a success! Because we love you so much, we decided to roll out an update just in time for summer.

Here's what you have to look forward to:

[h1]Update Overview[/h1]
[list][*]Summer Sale 50% (During sale dates)
[*]Cloud Saving
[*]13 New Achievements
[*]New Gimmicks
[*]Bug Fixes
[/list]
That is all for today! For any questions, feedback, or anything else, please feel free to comment to this post, or [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597670/discussions/]write a new thread in the forums[/url]. Once again, thank you for all the support, and we hope you will enjoy the update!

notes.title: Full Release Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for supporting Exterminator during early access. Your feedback was very helpful in preparing the game for full release. I am excited to finally announce that the full release will be (4/6). There are a few announcements I would like to give regarding the release.

The first topic of concern regards final version price. There has been some ambiguity in developer posts. Please note that we are a Japanese company and translational errors might have occurred. We sincerely apologize for any confusion. The price will not be changing to a full version price, but remaining the same as the early access price at $9.99.

That being said, there are many features that have been added to the game! We would love for you to play and discover the details for yourselves, but here is a rough explanation of new content:

*Difficulty – Easy, Normal, Hard, and Expert modes can now be played.
*Ranking Board – Fight for a spot on the leaderboards! Separated by difficulty.
*Throwable items – Mouse too far away? Try grabbing something nearby! Items increased.
*Mouse Types – The more the merrier. More types, more fun. Collect them all.

Once again, we thank you for your support! Happy punching.
